'''Patrick Stevens''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[November 2000 Namur tournament]] on 26 November 2000 with [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit]], according to Julien Riviere's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1498">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-27-namur-belgium-26-11-2000d1498/ namur-belgium-26-11-2000], DeckTech (Julien "Dark Padawan" Riviere, 27 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-27-namur-belgium-26-11-2000d1498/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
